newsitem.title: USA: Zell fund backs Revco takever by CVS.
newsitem.headline: Zell fund backs Revco takever by CVS.

text.p: An investment fund controlled by Chicago investor Sam Zell said Wednesday it has agreed with CVS Corp. to back its friendly takeover of Revco D.S. Inc.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the Zell/Chilmark Fund L.P. said it agreed with CVS on Feb. 6 that it would vote all of its 13,102,288 Revco common shares, about 19.2 percent of the total, in favor of the merger.
It said it agreed also not to sell or transfer its stock before Revco shareholders vote on the merger, valued at about $2.8 billion plus assumption of $900 million of Revco debt.
